flags.why: The Southern family title Ba indicates the second-born child, not necessarily the second-eldest sister.
flags.fix: My sister Ba, the second-born child in our family, sells bánh mì at the end of the alley.

flags.why: The locative sense is formal, as the gloss itself notes, but lacks the formal warning tag.
The gloss explicitly identifies potentially derogatory usage, but the tags do not warn the learner.
